[[File:Accutronics_planar_pincher.png|thumb|The Accutronics Modular Medium Planar Pincher]]
The '''Modular Medium Planar Pincher''' was a medium-sized manipulator part for [[Droid/Legends|droid]] built by [[AccuTronics/Legends|AccuTronics]]. Made of beryllium-aluminium, copper and titanium, it weighed 0.9 [[Kilogram/Legends|kilograms]], was of high durability but not magnetic. It was equipped with grabbing and tugging ability.
